-- Node: Query Financial & Debt Data
WITH latest_financials AS (
    SELECT
        report_date,
        total_assets,
        total_liabilities,
        total_equity,
        retained_earnings,
        current_assets,
        accounts_payable_total,
        short_term_debt,
        -- Calculate current liabilities
        (accounts_payable_total + short_term_debt) AS current_liabilities,
        revenue,
        cogs,
        operating_expenses,
        ebitda,
        ebit,  -- MUST include for depreciation calc
        -- Calculate depreciation
        (ebitda - ebit) AS depreciation,
        interest_expense,
        principal_repayments,
        total_debt,
        -- Additional useful fields
        long_term_debt,
        cash_total_egp_eq
    FROM financial_statements_monthly
    ORDER BY report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
debt_info AS (
    -- Calculate floating rate debt exposure
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding), 0) as total_floating_debt,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN interest_rate_type = 'Fixed' THEN principal_outstanding ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_fixed_debt,
        COUNT(*) as loan_count,
        COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN interest_rate_type = 'Floating' THEN spread ELSE NULL END), 0) as avg_floating_spread
    FROM debt_instruments  -- NOT "new_debt_instruments"
),
market_data AS (
    -- Get latest market rates
    SELECT
        egp_usd_rate,
        cbe_corridor_rate,
        risk_free_rate_eg,
        inflation_rate
    FROM market_indices_daily
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    lf.*,
    di.total_floating_debt,
    di.total_fixed_debt,
    di.loan_count,
    di.avg_floating_spread,
    md.egp_usd_rate,
    md.cbe_corridor_rate,
    md.risk_free_rate_eg,
    md.inflation_rate
FROM latest_financials lf
CROSS JOIN debt_info di  -- Use CROSS JOIN instead of comma
CROSS JOIN market_data md;
